title: Australia returns 3 ancient Indian artefacts
description: The National Gallery of Australia has formally handed over three ancient Indian artefacts to the Indian High Commission in Canberra, marking a significant step towards restoring India's cultural heritage. The transfer fulfils a commitment made by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese during the Third Annual Leaders' Summit in July 2026.
